title: Totai

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.16b.16): Rav Sheshet identifies the ruling as Totai’s, citing his statement, “to him and not to his creditor.”[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Kiddushin, Abaye reports Rav Sheshet’s identification of the baraita as Totai’s. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3539&lang=en) also records Rav Sheshet’s attribution to Totai.
